dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: anxious

dialogue.text: Her breath catches as she skids to a stop at the corner by the station.
The reason is still crumpled in her fist: a white slip of paper she found tucked inside her shoe that morning.
In neat blue ink, it had said only one thing.
..."Don't take the usual road to school."
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: anxious

dialogue.text: She had stood frozen in the entryway for ten whole minutes, reading it again and again.
I should've ignored it.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: sad

dialogue.text: But... it was inside my shoe.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: confused

dialogue.text: A delivery truck rumbles past the crossing ahead.
On the pavement beyond it, a bicycle lies on its side, its front wheel bent under the guardrail.
A small crowd gathers. The usual road is blocked by tape.
A chill slips down her back.
So that's why...?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: confused

dialogue.text: You going to Minase High too?
dialogue.speaker: Woman

dialogue.text: A woman in a beige coat stands beside the vending machines, as if she had been waiting there.
Y-yes.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: shy

dialogue.text: Then you'd better hurry. Entrance remarks start in twelve minutes.
dialogue.speaker: Woman

dialogue.text: Eh... how do you know that?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: And keep your student ID somewhere safer this year.
dialogue.speaker: Woman

dialogue.text: Aoi instinctively grabs her blazer pocket.
Empty.
...What?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: I haven't even received one yet.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: confused

dialogue.text: The woman smiles faintly. Not kindly. Not cruelly either.
Right. Not yet.
dialogue.speaker: Woman

dialogue.text: She presses something into Aoi's hand: a tiny brass charm shaped like a key, cold as ice.
If you hear your name before anyone calls it, don't answer.
dialogue.speaker: Woman

dialogue.text: W-wait.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: Who are you?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: confused

dialogue.text: A train screams into the station behind them.
For one second Aoi flinches at the wind and noise.
When she looks back, the beige coat is gone.
...No way.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: Only a receipt flutters near her shoes.
She picks it up with trembling fingers.
On the blank back, in the same blue ink, are the words:
"Class 1-C."
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: Her chest tightens. That class assignment has not been posted yet.
This isn't funny.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: angry

dialogue.text: The school bell rings faintly in the distance.
...I have to go.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: She closes her fingers around the brass key charm and starts running again.
This time, not just because she's late.
